subject.title: Translate https://crabbox.sh website in multi language

question: Should Crabbox own a maintained multilingual documentation program for `crabbox.sh`, and if so what initial locales and synchronization/review policy should it support?
rationale: The request adds an ongoing public documentation capability across the static-site generator and Markdown corpus; source inspection does not establish a supported locale set, translation owner, or acceptable freshness policy.

options.title: Keep English canonical for now
options.body: Defer implementation until a maintainer can sponsor a bounded locale program and ongoing translation review.

options.title: Fund a limited rollout
options.body: Choose specific initial locales, designate translation reviewers, and require automated stale-source detection before accepting the first translated pages.

recommendation.title: Keep English canonical for now
recommendation.body: Defer implementation until a maintainer can sponsor a bounded locale program and ongoing translation review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent documentation history makes this contributor the best available routing candidate for deciding whether the docs-site surface should take on ongoing localization ownership.
